tiersHtml:
Partner tiers

Hex’s program supports partners as they grow, offering tailored benefits at every stage of their journey.

Gigabyte

For partners who are just getting started working with Hex.

Why join

  • Referral commission
  • Crossbeam data share
  • Free Hex account
  • Access to training resources

Terabyte

For partners who have a track record of deep Hex knowledge and closing Hex business.

Everything in Gigabyte, plus:

  • Technical support
  • Marketing resources
  • Dedicated Slack channel
  • Access to Hex Partner Engineer

Petabyte

For partners who have demonstrated exceptional expertise and success in delivering Hex solutions.

Everything in Terabyte, plus:

  • Dedicated Partner Manager
  • Co-branded marketing materials
  • Spotlight on our website
  • Dedicated Office Hours
